notes.title: ChikPack - Coming SooN
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40539766/c9bb5d563fa2ca6bb5debf5b30203e3c03826cda.png[/img]


      [h3][u]The long-awaited release of Our project under the name:[/u][/h3]
               
                     [i][h1]Man's Club - "ChikPack" - To Night Girls Go UP!"[/h1][/i]
                
[u]-This project is not like the others, as it might seem. [/u]

[b]-Everyone can get the opportunity to participate in creating quality content and this is not a joke in the world of the "Men's Club"[/b]

[u]Send your portfolios and works, we will be very glad to new participants and fans of this direction of the game in Our international project![/u]

[b][u]Please do not judge strictly, we are just beginning ... [/u][/b] 

[u]We are ready for constructive criticism, we are pursuing the goal of making excellent content where Our project will not leave indifferent any fan of this style of games)[/u]
We will take into account all your wishes and correct mistakes that you will find, we really hope that we have taken everything into account and there will be more wishes ...
